requirement: The system shall compute the result of dividing two numbers and shall reject division by zero.

reference_scenarios.description: Dividing two ordinary nonzero numbers (e.g. 10 by 2) returns the correct quotient.
reference_scenarios.requirement_clause: compute the result of dividing two numbers

reference_scenarios.description: Dividing by zero is rejected: the system raises an error instead of returning a result, per the explicit requirement.
reference_scenarios.expected_result: raises ValueError instead of returning a result

reference_scenarios.description: Dividing by a very small nonzero denominator (e.g. 0.0001) succeeds and returns a large but valid result, distinguishing 'near zero' from 'exactly zero'.
reference_scenarios.precondition: very small nonzero denominator (0.0001), near but not equal to zero

reference_scenarios.description: A numerator of zero divided by a nonzero denominator returns 0, which is valid and distinct from the division-by-zero error case.
reference_scenarios.requirement_clause: compute the result of dividing two numbers
reference_scenarios.precondition: numerator is 0 with a nonzero denominator
reference_scenarios.expected_result: returns 0.0, distinct from the division-by-zero error

reference_scenarios.description: Both numerator and denominator are negative (e.g. -10 / -2), returning a correct positive result.
reference_scenarios.requirement_clause: compute the result of dividing two numbers
reference_scenarios.precondition: both numerator and denominator are negative

notes: This is the one reference requirement whose negative/error-path behavior is explicitly stated ('shall reject division by zero'), so neg_1 tests requirement-mandated error handling rather than an unvalidated gap like in the other files.
